propositions: Push recovery _recover_dirty_merge fails irreversibly when an untracked local file collides with a file the remote merge wants to create, leaving the store wedged on every retry
The untracked-overwrite wedge is the same class of failure as in reconverge merge-abort recovery (compaction leftovers such as *-SNAPSHOT.json and *.retired colliding with tracked files)

After quarantining named colliding untracked paths to git-common-dir/reconverge-quarantine/<utc-ts>/ and retrying merge exactly once, the recovery completes with both parents and tracked edits restored
Stash commit objects must be restored exactly once on every exit path (success, retry-failure, non-recoverable abort) to preserve tracked edits
The recovery reuses the shared sync parser _untracked_overwrite_paths and quarantine directory helpers to avoid duplicating the recovery mechanism across modules
